title: Zesty Grassy Korean Danmuji Onigiri
description: A light and refreshing Korean-inspired dish featuring danmuji and shaped like nigiri, served on a talavera plate. This anti-inflammatory friendly recipe is perfect for a snack or lunch.
instructions: Prepare the danmuji by slicing it into thin strips and setting it aside.
In a large bowl, mix together the cooled sushi rice, grassy turmeric, and sesame oil until well combined.
Add the chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds to the rice mixture and stir until they are evenly distributed.
Season the rice mixture with salt to taste.
Using wet hands, shape the rice mixture into small nigiri shapes and place a few strips of danmuji in the center of each one.
Fold the rice over the danmuji to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Serve the Zesty Grassy Korean Danmuji Onigiri on a talavera plate and garnish with additional green onions if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 24 hours.
Before serving, let the onigiri come to room temperature for about 30 minutes.
